scope: Selected curve works summary and exact rows, map, totals, list, sheets and JSON/CSV exports. Empty real curves prove honest empty selection, not local works or field safety. Two disconnected test-only grids prove nonempty crossing rank selection and sheet plans. Goal/stage packages and full browser acceptance remain open. This run does not prove performance.
